The record of the training run at 256x16 at its 19th network update, 25 November 2026: reads the snapshot of
the second part's logs taken at 17:16 (snapshot/: manifest.json, serving.jsonl, cpu_memory.log, keeper.log and
the supervisor's state files), writes the evidence file
docs/archive/records/training_256x16_update_19_2026_11_25.json and draws the record's figures in
docs/archive/records/figures/. Run from the repository root:
    python3 studies/campaign/runs/training-256x16-2026-11-25/report-2026-11-25/make_report.py
